main_text.p: Pafiphilus Glareano nihil admodum concesserit: Donatus illustratus comparatis veteribus reliquis Grammaticis,item Poëtę plerique Plautus,Perfius,Silius,Martialis:sacræ literę variis operibus explicatæ eruditam Buschii induftriam demonftrarunt. Ioannes Atrocianus in hac profeffione fcripfit elegiam de bello ruftico & epigrammata quædam:item fcholia in Macrum.XyftusBetuleius eruditis in Ciceronem plurimis, nonnullis etiam in fybillina oracula commentariis, fymphonia novi teftamenti clariffimus, Bafilienfis etiam juventutis informator fuit. His Thomas Platerus fucceffit uberrimi feminarii proventu cum innumerabiles annorum plurimorum tempore grammaticos genuit : tum filium felicem Platerum fic informavit,ut filii exemplo, fingularis patris doctrina poffit intelligi: perspexi enim & collaudavi fingulare felicis ingenium atque ad omnes artes mirifico naturæ impetu incitatum : tornandi artifex,fed animi cauffa,fingularis eft,eft & fundendi artifex fingularis,fed medicinæ quam facit,gratia : anatomica plerasque ftudiofius digefsit, herbarum ac ftirpium infinitam copiam ac fylvam quotidie novam exquirit,ut ad Nicolaum Deneu Parifienfem chirurgum & ῥιζοτόμον[?] regium, laude ista longe mortalium omnium ( de quibus audierim)facile principem proxime videatur accedere. Quare felice tali filio felicem & patrem meritissimo jure exiftimo. Ioan. Oporinus in hujus palmæ ftudio meditationes nobiles oftendit editis fcholiis in Solinum, Ciceronem, Demosthene: multo vero nobiliores oftensurus

page.notes: Show-through of a word ("Palphili") in the lower left is excluded. A small dot follows "Bu" at the end of line 4; it is not a hyphen, so "Buschii" is written whole. "infybillina" is set close together and may be "in sybillina"; marked [?] in the text. The Greek word ῥιζοτόμον is small and uncertain in its accents; marked [?]. "Quare" carries a Q with an underline, transcribed as printed. "nisi" is a catchword at the lower right.
